en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a public square with a prominent neoclassical building in the center. Behind the building, a large hill with a castle or fortress (Ljubljana Castle) rises in the background. The square is labeled 'Kongresni-trg.' The reverse side contains handwritten text, a postage stamp, and postal marks, indicating it was mailed.
